_comment: EP015 voice-over masters. Sizes are authoritative Drive file sizes in bytes; durations are derived from them, not measured. See _derivation.
_derivation: WAVs are 24000 Hz / 16-bit / mono = 48000 bytes per second. Verified two ways against the brief: Part 0 computes to 106.44s against the brief's stated 01:46.44 (exact), and Part 7 to 176.76s against its stated ~02:56. No other sample rate lands within 10% of both. Header overhead is <0.01s and is ignored.
_status: DOWNLOADED AND MEASURED. All 8 WAVs are in assets/audio/ as v00..v07.wav (gitignored - 51MB, re-pull from Drive if lost). Every measured duration matched the byte-size derivation to 0.00s. Word timings come from tools/align_audio.py, which finds real pauses in this audio - see README 'Audio timing'.
_retrieval: The Drive connector's download_file stages the file into the workspace rather than returning base64, so these transfer despite Drive egress being blocked. Command: download_file(file_id) -> assets/audio/. vo_full.wav is the 8 parts concatenated in order; rebuild with ffmpeg -f concat if lost.
